```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version number (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi) (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  draft-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Resolve model abbreviation
        id: select_model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Determine version
        id: determine_version
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=version::$(npm run version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version)"
        if: github.event.inputs.new_version == ''

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        run: |
          git checkout -b release/v$VERSION
          git add .
          git commit -m "Release v$VERSION"
          git push origin release/v$VERSION
          gh pr create --base main --head release/v$VERSION --title "Release v$VERSION" --body "This is a draft release."
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.version || github.event.inputs.new_version }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create draft GitHub release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: "v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.version || github.event.inputs.new_version }}"
          body: "This is a draft release."
          draft: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Trigger Publish Assets workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: 'publish-assets.yml'
          inputs: '{"release_branch": "release/v${{ steps.determine_version.outputs.version || github.event.inputs.new_version }}"}'
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

```yaml
name: Publish Assets

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build binaries
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload binaries to draft release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/*
          tag: "v${{ github.ref_name }}"
          asset_name: "dist.zip"
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
          make_latest: false
          release_id: ${{ needs.create_draft_release.outputs.release_id }}
```

name: Publish

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Publish Assets"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  publish-to-npm:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
